subject: Customer debrief: outage timeline, mitigations, and self-service runbook
messages:
From: Stephanie Nguyen <stephanie_nguyen@redwood.com>
To: Anna Liu <anna.liu@oakridgefin.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>, Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.com>
Date: Tue, 14 Sep 2027 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Customer debrief: outage timeline, mitigations, and self-service runbook

Hi Anna —

Thank you for your patience this morning. I wanted to share a concise summary of what we know so far, the mitigations we applied in real time, and the next deliverables you can expect from us. We will follow up with a full RCA and a runnable playbook by tomorrow afternoon.

Summary (short):
- Impact: several inference nodes serving Oakridge model variant experienced elevated CPU/GP memory thrashing that caused request queuing and increased tail latency for ~42 minutes (08:13–08:55 PT).
- Root cause (prelim): a recent autoscaling policy change combined with a change in workload token distribution created a pathological batching window; combined with a memory leak in the model shard allocator, this pushed utilization above the scheduled headroom.
- Immediate mitigations applied: reverted autoscaling tweak, added temporary capacity pool (2x nodes) to affected shard group, enabled aggressive KV-cache priming for hot prefixes.

Attachments: oakridge_post-incident-timeline.pdf (timeline + short logs), oakridge_mitigations_summary.xlsx (actions applied).

Next steps (what Redwood will deliver):
1) By EOD tomorrow (09/15): full RCA PDF with root cause analysis and test artifacts.
2) By 09/17: a customer-runbook (oakridge_runbook.md) with steps your SREs can use for self-triage and safe failover to the dedicated pool.
3) We will schedule a 30-minute sync with your ops team to walk through the runbook and the SLA credit request process — tentatively 09/16 or 09/17 based on your availability.

Immediate ask from Oakridge: please confirm whether you need us to export additional logs (we can push a 7-day bundle to your secure S3) and if you prefer the sync at 09/16 10:00 AM PT or 09/17 2:00 PM PT.

Again, apologies for the disruption. We understand how critical inference latency is for your fraud-detection pipeline and are treating this with high priority.

Thanks,

Stephanie Nguyen
Senior Account Executive, Redwood Inference
stephanie_nguyen@redwood.com
+1 415-555-0198

--
Redwood Inference | Developer-first inference runtime

Anna Liu

Team — looping you in to coordinate deliverables for Oakridge. Anna confirmed 09/16 10:00 AM PT for the sync. Action items below; please reply with ownership and ETA.

Actions (proposed):
- Detailed RCA PDF (including memory allocator traces, kernel-level sched logs) — owner: Hannah — ETA: 09/15 3:00 PM PT.
- Log export: 7-day bundle with full request/response IDs, and separate slice for 08:30–09:00 with the IDs Anna requested — owner: Ben — ETA: 09/14 4:30 PM PT (generate S3 link, set Oakridge-only ACL).
- Runbook for Oakridge on-call: short playbook (5–7 steps) + failover checklist + commands to trigger temporary capacity pool — owner: Marissa — ETA: 09/17 11:00 AM PT (MD + markdown).
- SLA credit intake: draft the credit request template and list the evidence needed from the customer — owner: Stephanie — ETA: 09/15 10:00 AM PT.

Notes: Hannah — please include the mitigation validation steps we ran (KV-cache priming sequence) and the small repro test we used to verify the allocator fix. Ben — we should not include any raw PII in the log export; redact per policy but keep request/response IDs intact.

Thanks — happy to jump on a quick 20-min internal call if helpful.

-Steph

Subject: Oakridge post-incident deliverables: RCA, timeline, runbook, and next steps

Hi Anna —

Per our commitments, attached are the deliverables from Redwood following the outage on 2027-09-14. Quick summary up front, then attachments and next steps below.

What happened (concise):
- 08:13 PT: autoscaler adjustment pushed additional small-batch windows; a workload token-distribution shift caused many requests to land on the same KV-hot prefixes.
- 08:23–08:50 PT: model shard allocator leak coupled with a pathological batching window led to memory pressure and queueing; some requests observed >2.5x tail latency.
- 08:55 PT: mitigation finished (revert + capacity + priming) and latency returned to baseline.

Attachments included:
- oakridge_rca_final.pdf — full RCA (5 pages), root cause analysis, mitigation validation artifacts, and recommended permanent controls.
- oakridge_post-incident-timeline.pdf — event timeline and short log snippets.
- oakridge_runbook.md — 1-page runbook with triage commands, how to trigger the dedicated pool, and safe-fallback checks.

High-level action items (owner / ETA):
- Permanent allocator fix and unit/integration tests — Hannah Schmitt / 09/30.
- Autoscaling policy guardrail: add token-distribution-aware threshold and an opt-out for dedicated pools — Ben Carter / 09/24.
- Runbook walkthrough with Oakridge SRE + dry-run on staging — Marissa Cole / meeting on 09/16 10:00 AM PT (confirmed).
- SLA credit intake: Stephanie to send credit-request form and evidence checklist today; Oakridge to reply with any additional supporting artifacts.

SLA credit process: attach the completed credit intake spreadsheet (we included a filled example). For formal processing we need: incident window (we have it), service IDs (provided in the RCA), and confirmation of affected request IDs (you may point us to any additional IDs). Once we receive those, we will open the formal credit review and update within 7 business days.

Security and data handling: log export follows our standard PII redaction; if Oakridge requires a different redaction profile, let us know and we will regenerate. The S3 export link (Oakridge-only ACL) will be delivered separately by Ben.

Please reply if you need anything else ahead of the 09/16 walkthrough. If Anna confirms, we'll send the calendar invite to Anna + Oakridge SRE + Marissa + Hannah.

Thanks again for the partnership — we take responsibility for this impact and are committed to preventing recurrence.

Best,

Stephanie Nguyen
Senior Account Executive, Redwood Inference
stephanie_nguyen@redwood.com
+1 415-555-0198
